title: .onerc.yaml v1
description: Scope file format declaring per-service allow/deny permission patterns. Default deny strict.

version.description: Schema version. Only 1 is supported in this version of One CLI.

defaults.description: Per-service default account alias (overridden by services.<id>.account).

permissionPattern.description: A permission path with optional single-level wildcard suffix. Disallowed: **, ?, brace expansion.

account.description: Account alias to use when invoking this service (defaults to "default").

allow.description: Permissions granted. Empty list = nothing allowed (default deny).

deny.description: Permissions explicitly denied. Deny always wins over allow.
